name: 語幹
label: The adjective stem

etymology.mnemonic: A tree trunk with the branches cut off. In 高い, the trunk is 高; the い is a branch. な-adjectives and nouns are already bare trunks: 静か, 学生.

description: The part of an adjective that stays put. For い-adjectives it is the word minus い. For な-adjectives and nouns it is the whole word.
